fact_text: An uptrend is a series of higher highs and higher lows, while a downtrend is a series of lower highs and lower lows.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '13. How to Use Parallel Channel Tool in Technical Analysis | PSX & Pakistan Stock Market Guide' (YouTube, 2024-10-26)

fact_text: A parallel channel is drawn by joining the lows of an uptrend, then running a parallel line through the highs, and price is read as moving between those two lines.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '13. How to Use Parallel Channel Tool in Technical Analysis | PSX & Pakistan Stock Market Guide' (YouTube, 2024-10-26)

fact_text: While price holds inside a channel, the analyst plans sells or profit-taking near the upper line and buys near the lower line, and a downtrend channel shows rejection at its top.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '13. How to Use Parallel Channel Tool in Technical Analysis | PSX & Pakistan Stock Market Guide' (YouTube, 2024-10-26)

fact_text: A close outside the channel, especially on heavy volume, is treated as a breakout signal, which the analyst said can be followed by a sharp move in the new direction.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '13. How to Use Parallel Channel Tool in Technical Analysis | PSX & Pakistan Stock Market Guide' (YouTube, 2024-10-26)
